brand_notes: SVS (Youngstown OH; subwoofer heritage; direct-to-consumer plus dealers; manufactured in China, 5-yr warranty). Prime Bookshelf: 8 ohm label but measured 3.9 ohm min / EPDR 2.2; maker 48 Hz claim vs 70 Hz measured f3 (eac-svs-prime-bookshelf). Ultra Evolution Bookshelf also rated 6 ohm with 3.7 ohm min (stereophile-svs-ultra-evolution-bookshelf).
takeaways: EAC Klippel: LW ±2.3 dB, f3 70 Hz vs 48 Hz claim, wide directivity (144/115 deg).
Min impedance 3.9 ohm, EPDR 2.2 ohm: effectively-4ohm despite 8 ohm label.
THD ~0.7% @86 dB, ~1.3% @96 dB (graph-read); ≤1.7 dB compression at 102 dB.
Erin found midrange forward and highs bright on-axis; EQ -3 dB at 1-2 kHz or aim out.
$699/pair in stock at World Wide Stereo; no independent user reports retrievable.
conflicts: Claimed 48 Hz (±3 dB) vs measured f3 70 Hz
8 ohm nominal vs 3.9 ohm measured minimum
log_bullets: Conflicts: bass extension claim vs f3; impedance flagged effectively-4ohm (3.9 ohm)
